q: Which greenhouse gases should we include in BRSR Scope 1 and 2?
title: Which gases to include in BRSR
short: All seven Kyoto gases, reported together in tonnes of CO2e: carbon dioxide, methane, nitrous oxide, HFCs, PFCs, sulphur hexafluoride and nitrogen trifluoride. BRSR asks for a breakdown by gas if available. For most Indian manufacturers, CO2 from fuel and electricity dominates, with HFCs from refrigerant top-ups next.

ul: CO2: fuel, process emissions, grid electricity.
Methane and nitrous oxide: combustion, wastewater, biomass boilers.
HFCs: air conditioners, chillers and cold rooms.

p: Multiply each gas by its global warming potential and state which IPCC assessment report the values come from. Use the same set every year.

sections.h: If you cannot split by gas
p: Report the total and say the breakdown is not available. Grid electricity factors from CEA are given as CO2, which is acceptable for Scope 2.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel invoices, gas bills and delivery documents into dated, fingerprinted records, so each tonne of CO2 traces back to the document behind it.
